newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 50 bln bolivar TEM auction Wed.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 50 bln bolivar TEM auction Wed.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Wednesday morning a 30 billion bolivar ($63 million) auction of 180-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills with a 27.93 percent coupon.
The bank said it would also offer 10 billion bolivars ($21 million) in 269-day bills with a 28.87 percent coupon and another 10 billion bolivars of 358-day bills with a 29.86 percent coupon.

Coupons are significantly down from last week's issue when 180-, 269- and 358-day notes carried 34.12, 35.52 and 36.99 respectively. The issue also exceeds the 10 billion bolivars of TEMs due to mature on Thursday.
The weekly TEM bill auctions are the Central Bank's principal tool of monetary policy, used to restrict liquidity and establish a benchmark for wider interest rates.
